content.comment_body: The support article with [article_no] currently provides an incorrect manual in the download section. While the 'Display and Configure' feature shows the correct manual (dated 11/2017) and references the appropriate validity and order number for the updated [product_name], using the 'Download' function actually offers an outdated manual from 05/2017.
Hello, I attempted to download from the link mentioned above. I was able to obtain the most recent file (11/2017), consistent with the number shown on the manual's first page.
I've retried the download process. Using the 'Download' function still results in receiving the 05/2017 manual. Only through 'Show and Configure' does the correct 11/2017 manual appear.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have found that the version available for viewing ('Show and Configure') is current, but the downloadable file is not, resulting in confusion over which manual version is officially accessible. This highlights an issue with both user experience and content management accuracy.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the manual available for download should match the most recent version shown by the 'Display and Configure' feature, specifically making the latest manual (11/2017) readily downloadable.
